en.native.full.style.animation.flipchild.be: Captures visible in-flow HTMLElement children in CSS order before a configured child event, then animates their changed positions after the paired event. Popup triggers are ignored; seq delays can spread from a captured reference child.
en.native.full.style.animation.flipchild.ca: Display-none, absolute and fixed children are excluded from the captured layout items. This style responds to event pairs rather than observing every layout mutation.
en.native.full.style.animation.flipchild.co: Combine with child entry/exit styles so appearing content and moving peers have separate animation responsibilities.
en.native.full.style.animation.flipchild.li: Registers before/after event listeners; teardown removes those listeners and the style data.
en.native.full.style.animation.flipchild.pr: Apply to the parent whose children emit the configured before/after child events. Arbitrary DOM changes without those events do not trigger this style.
en.native.full.style.animation.flipchild.pu: Animate sibling reflow after children are added, removed, shown or hidden.
en.native.full.style.animation.intersection: Observes matching targets in each child subtree and blocks entry on their showing readiness promise. Hiding before first appearance cancels the pending showing callback and makes the next attempt wait briefly.

This gates the first showing event; it is not a repeated scroll-reveal animation. The child filter controls observed mutations, so keep the initial children and target matches compatible with framework readiness methods.
Apply to a parent and give its targets an animation.entry style. The styled parent is the observation root by default; set option.root to null to observe against the browser viewport.
Removed targets are unobserved and their entry blockers are removed. Style teardown disconnects its intersection and child observers.
Use framework elements exposing onReady and trigger as matched targets, with IntersectionObserver available. target selects within each child; the default :scope targets that child itself.
Delay a child entry animation until its first observed intersection within the configured observation root.
en.native.full.style.animation.lifecycle: Mount creates the animation. Unmount, style teardown or host destruction cancels the stored animation for that setup; a later mount can create a fresh animation while the style remains installed.
en.native.full.style.animation.prerequisite: Provide valid Web Animations keyframes and a host supporting Element.animate.
en.native.full.style.animation.purpose: Play caller-supplied keyframes on an element.
en.native.full.style.attrs.behavior: Argument entries become kebab-case attribute names; null or undefined values are skipped.
en.native.full.style.attrs.caveats: Pass the actual attribute entries; the factory forwards the entire argument dictionary and does not unwrap an attrs subobject.
en.native.full.style.attrs.composition: Choose the path for the intended host, slotted content, or slot wrapper; a slot wrapper and the content assigned to it are different targets.
en.native.full.style.attrs.lifecycle: Property, class, and attribute plugins retain prior values for style removal; asynchronous target lookup checks that the application is still active.
en.native.full.style.attrs.purpose: Set DOM attributes on the path-selected target.
en.native.full.style.auto.adjustFont.behavi: Runs immediately and on configured host events through an animation-frame throttle; an optional descendant selector chooses the text target.
en.native.full.style.auto.adjustFont.caveat: This measures text layout, not arbitrary rich child geometry. Teardown removes listeners and the marker class but does not restore the previous inline font size.
en.native.full.style.auto.adjustFont.compos: Set the target size and line height before applying the style; choose triggers for content changes as well as resize when necessary.
en.native.full.style.auto.adjustFont.prereq: Requires measurable text and a resolved line height other than normal.
en.native.full.style.auto.adjustFont.purpos: Fit text to the available target dimensions.
en.native.full.style.auto.badge.behavior: Scans existing text nodes and replaces matching bracket expressions with jam-badge markup; dir controls the vertical class.
en.native.full.style.auto.badge.caveats: The transformation rewrites parent innerHTML once, can replace existing child nodes, and provides no inverse transformation or mutation observer.
en.native.full.style.auto.badge.prerequisit: Use stable content whose parent markup can be rewritten.
en.native.full.style.auto.badge.purpose: Turn bracketed caption/value text into inline badges.
en.native.full.style.auto.colored.behavior: Adds jam-auto-colored; the stylesheet targets compatible icons and the exposed agent part under jam-colorprofile.
en.native.full.style.auto.colored.caveats: It does not choose a color profile or recolor every descendant.
en.native.full.style.auto.colored.prerequis: The host needs a color profile and the corresponding icon or agent structure.
en.native.full.style.auto.colored.purpose: Use the host color profile for its icon and internal agent foreground.
en.native.full.style.auto.focus.behavior: Schedules focus after repaint; an optional regular expression locates the selection range in the value.
en.native.full.style.auto.focus.caveats: This owns focus movement, so avoid competing autofocus controllers.
en.native.full.style.auto.focus.lifecycle: Mount installs focus and unmount listeners; style teardown removes those listeners.
en.native.full.style.auto.focus.prerequisit: The host must be focusable. Selection additionally requires a string-like value and an agent supporting setSelectionRange.
en.native.full.style.auto.focus.purpose: Focus an element after mount and return focus to a previous auto-focus element when it unmounts.
en.native.full.style.auto.hideIf.empty.beha: Evaluates on initial connection and optionchange, toggling jam-hide from the host data.
en.native.full.style.auto.hideIf.empty.cave: This tests data emptiness, not rendered child count. Removing the event listener does not restore the previous hide class.
en.native.full.style.auto.hideIf.empty.prer: Use a host with the option data and optionchange contract.
en.native.full.style.auto.hideIf.empty.purp: Hide an option-based host when its data is empty.
en.native.full.style.auto.hideIf.valueIs0.b: Evaluates on initial connection and valuechange, toggling jam-hide for null, undefined, or numeric 0.
en.native.full.style.auto.hideIf.valueIs0.c: The string "0" does not match numeric zero. Removing the event listener does not restore the previous hide class.
en.native.full.style.auto.hideIf.valueIs0.p: Use a host exposing value and valuechange.
Hide an input-like host when its value is absent or the number zero.
en.native.full.style.auto.keepScrollPositio: Stores pixel offsets under the host id on route change or unload; restoration can wait for a delay callback and asks viewport controllers to prepare the required extent.
Use with supported lazy or virtual viewport controllers so deep offsets can be prepared before restoration.
Unmount and removal cancel pending restoration and remove listeners; user scrolling or navigation input cancels the pending restore.
The host needs a stable id; an optional selector resolves the scroll target.
Restore a stable scroll position when returning to mounted content.
en.native.full.style.auto.moveAlong.behavio: After mount and a delay, periodically measures the target centroid and updates a translation through MelonMove; it reuses an existing move helper when present.
en.native.full.style.auto.moveAlong.caveats: Delayed setup and pending movement completions check that their application is still current; obsolete completions do not update the host. This invalidates continuations rather than cancelling arbitrary promises. Existing move helpers are reused and are not removed by this style.
en.native.full.style.auto.moveAlong.composi: Reserve transform and movement ownership for this style or deliberately coordinate with other movement plugins.
en.native.full.style.auto.moveAlong.lifecyc: Unmount, style teardown or host destruction clears the active interval, movement class and variables, owned checkpoint, and any move helper created by this style. A later mount starts a new setup while the style remains installed.
en.native.full.style.auto.moveAlong.prerequ: The target selector must resolve after the delay; selectors beginning with a colon are resolved relative to the host.
en.native.full.style.auto.moveAlong.purpose: Keep an element moving with a target element position.
en.native.full.style.auto.scrollAlong.behav: After delayed mount, listens to the source scroll event and copies scroll percentages to the host or scrollTarget; a marker avoids reciprocal feedback.
en.native.full.style.auto.scrollAlong.cavea: Synchronization copies percentages, not pixels. It does not perform an initial copy before a source scroll event. Obsolete delayed setup and queued callbacks cannot update a removed or replaced application; the underlying delay promise is not cancelled.
en.native.full.style.auto.scrollAlong.lifec: Unmount, style teardown or host destruction removes the source scroll listener, cancels the owned animation frame and timeout, and removes the scrolling marker only when this setup added it. Delayed setup checks its application identity; a later mount can start a fresh setup.
en.native.full.style.auto.scrollAlong.prere: Both selectors must resolve and the destination must have scrollable extent.
en.native.full.style.auto.scrollAlong.purpo: Make a scrollable target follow another element’s relative scroll position.
The atomic style writes the supplied value to background-attachment.
Use the broader background style when several related properties should be configured together.
Set background-attachment independently on the target.
en.native.full.style.background.behavior: Combines image, position, size, repeat, attachment, color, or the CSS background shorthand.
en.native.full.style.background.bubbles.beh: Builds randomized radial gradients and derives bubble size from the host height at application time.
en.native.full.style.background.bubbles.cav: This is generated background paint, not bubble DOM or animation; it does not install a resize regeneration listener.
en.native.full.style.background.bubbles.pre: The host needs a measurable height for size conversion.
en.native.full.style.background.bubbles.pur: Paint a decorative field of gradient bubbles.
en.native.full.style.background.caveats: Choose the path for the intended host, slotted content, or slot wrapper; a slot wrapper and the content assigned to it are different targets.
en.native.full.style.background.chess.behav: Builds a repeating conic pattern from the configured colors and sets the tile dimensions to twice size.
en.native.full.style.background.chess.compo: Use for a decorative pattern or transparency-style backdrop; reserve background-image ownership for this pattern or explicitly compose image layers.
en.native.full.style.background.color.behav: The atomic style writes the supplied value to background-color.
en.native.full.style.background.color.compo: Use the broader background style when several related properties should be configured together.
en.native.full.style.background.color.purpo: Set background-color independently on the target.
en.native.full.style.background.composition: Use background.color or a semantic preset for a simple fill; avoid a shorthand when unrelated background longhands must survive.
en.native.full.style.background.crystal.beh: Adds the crystal background class, which layers linear and radial gradients and uses different rules below a dark ancestor.
en.native.full.style.background.crystal.com: Combine with readable foreground roles and suitable size; the effect uses background-image rather than child layers.
en.native.full.style.background.crystal.pur: Paint an accent-based crystal-like gradient surface.
en.native.full.style.background.default.cav: These are local style applications. Reusable palette and scale changes belong to theme tokens; applying a preset does not redefine the theme.
en.native.full.style.background.default.com: Pair the fill with a foreground role appropriate to that surface. Choose the path for the intended host, slotted content, or slot wrapper; a slot wrapper and the content assigned to it are different targets.
en.native.full.style.background.elevated.ca: These are local style applications. Reusable palette and scale changes belong to theme tokens; applying a preset does not redefine the theme.
en.native.full.style.background.elevated.co: Pair the fill with a foreground role appropriate to that surface. Choose the path for the intended host, slotted content, or slot wrapper; a slot wrapper and the content assigned to it are different targets.
en.native.full.style.background.glassify.be: Sets a translucent background, radial highlight image, background positioning and scale, and a backdrop blur.
en.native.full.style.background.glassify.ca: The helper supplies paint properties only; it does not create a layer, establish layout, or guarantee foreground contrast.

The type profile misspells optKey as optKet, so type is emitted literally instead of animationType; do not promise that mapping.
Control animation for a mark-line or mark-point annotation.
Sets markLine data to a named average annotation and formats its label as name plus value; position and rotation configure the label.
The annotation name is fixed in the implementation; use markLine.data for custom naming or multiple references.
Writes markLine data, symbols, precision and silent behavior; children style its label, stroke, emphasis and animation.
Use avg for an average annotation or x/y for a reference at a given axis value.
Writes the chosen annotation label with ordinary label formatting, distance and position, plus border, shadow and typography children.
Writes the markLine lineStyle and extends the common line-stroke profile with curveness.
Writes one markLine item with xAxis and optional yValue/caption metadata, then formats the label from those values.
y is label metadata, not a second endpoint. A zero y value is omitted from the extra label text because the formatter uses a truthiness check.
Add a reference line at an x-axis value.
Writes one markLine item with yAxis and optional caption metadata, formatting the label from the value and caption.
Add a reference line at a y-axis value.
en.native.full.style.echarts.line.markPoint: Writes markPoint data, symbol settings and silent behavior, with label, itemStyle, emphasis and animation children.
Use max/min for built-in extrema or provide data for custom annotations.
Writes one markPoint item with type max and a fixed name, with configurable symbol and symbol size.
Writes one markPoint item with type min and a fixed name, with configurable symbol and symbol size.
en.native.full.style.echarts.line.parts.beh: Reads column one, sets min=(3*minimum-maximum)/2 and max=(3*maximum-minimum)/2, and divides twice the data range by part for the rounded interval.
en.native.full.style.echarts.line.parts.cav: Only the first value column is considered. Constant/empty data and zero or invalid part are not guarded; this is not automatic scaling for every series.
en.native.full.style.echarts.line.parts.pre: Requires a nonempty numeric header-row dataset and a yAxis object.
en.native.full.style.echarts.line.parts.pur: Expand the y-axis range around the first dataset value column.
en.native.full.style.echarts.line.prerequis: Select line as the element chart type; the style does not create data or change series.type.
en.native.full.style.echarts.line.purpose: Configure a smooth Cartesian line chart.
en.native.full.style.echarts.line.symbol.be: Maps symbol, show, size, offset and rotate to series symbol fields; show defaults true.
en.native.full.style.echarts.line.symbol.co: Use this after the basic line style to reveal symbols hidden by that preset.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.background: Initializes and merges layer and label options into defaultOption.background; non-MedlarMap elements are ignored.
Teardown removes plugin data but does not restore the previously merged background defaults.
Requires MedlarMap and its background-region rendering path.
Style the contextual background layer of a MedlarMap.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.behavior: Initializes foreground and label defaults if absent, then merges map-layer options into defaultOption.top. It returns without effect on non-MedlarMap elements.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.compositio: Use background for context regions, state for the highlighted boundary and layer for additional decorative geography.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.dense.beha: On mount creates DurianDense with a pixel-resolved gap and listens for childreposition; each event computes configured density classes, attributes or variables.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.dense.cave: The listener is event-driven and this style does not perform an immediate compute at mount.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.dense.life: Unplug removes the childreposition listener and plugin data.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.fake3D.beh: Configures the foreground and composes bottom and middle layers with separate color, opacity, offset, border and shadow settings. Layer merging defaults on when that layer has an explicit color.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.fake3D.cav: This is layered 2D geometry, not ECharts-GL extrusion. Use mergeMid/mergeBottom explicitly when regional boundaries should be retained despite a uniform color.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.fake3D.pre: Requires the MedlarMap base geography and layer pipeline.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.fake3D.pur: Simulate map depth with offset 2D geography layers.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.layer.beha: Builds a silent geo layer from the base geography and colored regions; merge optionally unions the colored regions into one registered geography before appending it.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.layer.cave: No layer is appended when merge cannot obtain geometry. Layer offsets belong to the map alignment pipeline, not CSS translation.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.layer.imag: Loads the image asynchronously and appends a pattern-filled geo layer. Repeat defaults to repeat; useZoom defaults true only for no-repeat.
Image offsets shift the pattern by chart-height units and are not forwarded as geometry offsets. Scaling uses the chart height when useZoom is enabled. Image-load failures propagate after logging.
The draw function awaits image loading before adding the layer; loaded canvases are cached by source.
Requires MedlarMap, a nonempty image source, loaded base geography and nonzero chart/image dimensions.
Fill colored map regions with an image pattern.
On regionchange looks up images by the current region identifier, accepts an object with an image source, and registers an owned draw task to load and append the layer.
Bare string values are ignored. Missing entries do not add a new task. The style responds to regionchange rather than immediately applying the current region on attachment.
Requires MedlarMap and a dictionary of region identifiers to image-layer configuration objects.
Choose an image-layer configuration for each map region.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.layer.prer: Requires MedlarMap with a base geo layer; merge also requires its registered GeoJSON.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.layer.purp: Append a decorative geography layer to MedlarMap.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.lifecycle: This mutates defaultOption; teardown removes plugin bookkeeping but does not restore the previous defaults.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.prerequisi: Requires MedlarMap with its region/map loading pipeline.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.purpose: Style the foreground regions in the MedlarMap pipeline.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.state.beha: Replaces defaultOption.state with an itemStyle using a thin border and zero shadow blur; non-MedlarMap elements are ignored.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.state.life: Teardown removes plugin data without restoring the previous state defaults.
en.native.full.style.echarts.map.state.purp: Apply the preset boundary treatment to the highlighted map region.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.behavior: Adds the basic tooltip style and maps declared pie arguments onto series; itemStyle, label and emphasis are separate child styles.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.caveats: The source forwards selectOffset and persentPrecision literally; it does not correct these spellings to other ECharts option keys. The inherited tooltip defaults to axis trigger; use tooltip.itemTrigger for item-triggered pie tooltips.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.doubleCirc: Replaces data of the first two series with nominal 48-part rings and fixes their radii; the active counts use source[1][1]/source[2][1] and source[1][2]/source[2][1].

Ratios are not clamped: values above the denominator may generate more than 48 active segments. The top argument is not forwarded. This is a specific two-value display, not an arbitrary nested-pie builder.
Requires a header-row dataset with at least two value columns, both referenced data rows, two pie series, two palette colors and a valid nonzero denominator.
Render two segmented concentric progress rings.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.electronic: Uses source[1][1]/source[2][1] to compute an angle, replaces the first series with 24 equal segments and appends a background pie and a silent polar scatter pointer.

The angle is reduced modulo 180, so a full ratio wraps to zero rather than stopping at the end. Ratios are not validated or clamped. This replaces coordinate options and series presentation and hides tooltip content.
Requires the two referenced numeric dataset values, a nonzero denominator, a pie series and a palette color.
Render a segmented semicircular progress scale with a pointer.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.hover.beha: Writes series.emphasis, extending the shared emphasis profile with scale and scaleSize, and exposes emphasis labels and item styling.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.hover.cave: The shared focused argument remains literally focused; use explicit ECharts options when a verified focus property is required.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.hover.purp: Configure pie emphasis and its scale effect.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.position.b: Maps innerR and outerR into series.radius and cX/cY into series.center, with percentage-string defaults.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.position.c: A nonzero inner radius produces a ring; use explicit values when composing with ring or other presets that also write radii.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.position.p: Set pie center and inner/outer radii together.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.prerequisi: Select pie as the chart type or supply pie series separately.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.ring.behav: Removes labelLine and roseType, sets ring radii, hides the normal central label, enables a bold emphasis label and centers the title.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.ring.compo: Supply title text separately and apply explicit geometry afterward if a different center or radius is needed.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.ring.desc: Use a ring layout with a central emphasis label.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.ring.purpo: Use a ring layout with a central emphasis label.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.roseType.b: Writes series.roseType from type, defaulting to radius and offering radius or area.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.roseType.c: Use with a pie series. Applying pie.ring removes roseType during option merging.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.shadow.beh: At draw time merges the large theme shadow and any explicit shadow fields into every series.itemStyle.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.shadow.cav: This function visits every current series; it does not filter by series type.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.shadow.pur: Add a theme-default shadow to every pie item style.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.tz.behavio: Configures radii, center and segment padding, hides normal labels in the center and supplies a rich formatter based on the first two dataset dimensions; enables emphasis labels.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.tz.caveats: The default radius array is emitted as supplied by the preset. The emphasis textStyle call uses fontSize instead of the helper size argument; set label typography explicitly when needed.
en.native.full.style.echarts.pie.tz.prerequ: Use a pie series with category/value dimensions matching the formatter.
en.native.full.style.echarts.prerequisites: Use on a CashewChart-derived chart with ECharts available and a measurable host size.
en.native.full.style.echarts.purpose: Provide the default ECharts plot layout for chart elements.
en.native.full.style.echarts.radar.behavior: Uses first-column row names as indicators and each value column as one radar series value array; defaults the radar coordinate shape to circle.
en.native.full.style.echarts.radar.caveats: Replaces radar.indicator and each series.data during draw. Use echarts.Radar for raw coordinate configuration without this conversion.
en.native.full.style.echarts.radar.prerequi: Requires dataset[0].source with a header row and a matching series for each value column.
en.native.full.style.echarts.radar.purpose: Convert a header-row dataset into radar series.
en.native.full.style.echarts.shadow.item.be: Writes series.itemStyle shadow offset, blur and color directly, with rem-based defaults.
en.native.full.style.echarts.shadow.item.co: Use itemStyle.shadow for theme-backed shadow dictionaries and pie.shadow for its theme-default all-series preset.
en.native.full.style.echarts.shadow.item.de: Apply a uniform native shadow to series items.
en.native.full.style.echarts.shadow.item.pu: Apply a uniform native shadow to series items.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.behavior: Writes the title option, including text, links, alignment, visibility, background and margins; title and subtitle have separate textStyle owners.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.center.b: Sets title top and left to center and z to 10, also emitting a title-level fontSize value.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.center.c: The preset emits fontSize at title level rather than title.textStyle; configure title typography through textStyle.
Used by pie.ring for central content; set title.text separately.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.center.p: Center the title over the chart.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.composit: Use title.textStyle and title.subtextStyle for typography, and position for layout.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.hide.beh: Writes title.show=false while retaining other title options.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.position: Writes all four title margins and padding through the position helper; title padding defaults to a top inset of 10.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.purpose: Configure chart title and subtitle content and placement.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.subtextS: Writes font properties, overflow behavior, line height and dimensions to the selected textStyle/subtextStyle owner, with glyph-border and text-shadow children.
Configure title, subtitle or tooltip typography.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.subtitle: The helper writes font fields under title[副标题字体], rather than title.subtextStyle.
Do not rely on this helper for subtitle typography; use echarts.title.subtextStyle. The mismatched output key is preserved here, not repaired by metadata.
Identify the legacy subtitle-font helper and its current limitation.
Writes title.itemGap, defaulting to 10.
The exported spelling is subtitlePostion; this sets the gap rather than independent subtitle coordinates.
Set the spacing between title and subtitle.
en.native.full.style.echarts.title.titleFon: Writes fontStyle, fontWeight, fontFamily and fontSize into title.textStyle.
Set title typography with the legacy font helper.
en.native.full.style.echarts.tooltip.behavi: Writes tooltip triggering, display, formatting and positioning options, defaulting to axis trigger and confine=true; child styles configure the box, typography and axis pointer.
en.native.full.style.echarts.tooltip.compos: Use itemTrigger for per-item tooltips and pointer for crosshair/line/shadow configuration. The hide child removes the tooltip option.
en.native.full.style.echarts.tooltip.hide.b: Emits the deletion marker for tooltip during option merging.
en.native.full.style.echarts.tooltip.itemTr: Composes the basic tooltip helper with trigger=item, retaining its other defaults such as confinement.
Show tooltips for individual data items.
Show tooltips for individual data items.
en.native.full.style.echarts.tooltip.restri: Writes tooltip.confine=true without changing its content or trigger.
Keep tooltip placement confined to the chart.
Keep tooltip placement confined to the chart.
en.native.full.style.echarts.tooltip.toolti: The helper writes font fields under a top-level 字体.textStyle object rather than tooltip.textStyle.
Use echarts.tooltip.textStyle for tooltip typography. The top-legend array entry 2 aliases this same legacy helper.
Identify the legacy tooltip-font helper and its current limitation.
en.native.full.style.echarts.visualMap.beha: Writes visualMap bounds, selected range, dimension/series selection and display settings; show defaults false.
en.native.full.style.echarts.visualMap.cave: outRange and hoverlink are forwarded literally rather than normalized to ECharts outOfRange/hoverLink. The argument factory also passes the imported override function instead of its argsOverrides parameter; no inferred override support is claimed.
en.native.full.style.echarts.visualMap.comp: Provide the intended series and data dimension separately; this does not derive bounds from the dataset.
en.native.full.style.echarts.visualMap.purp: Configure a visual mapping option for chart data.
en.native.full.style.element.header.behavio: Adds header and level-specific classes consumed by the element document stylesheet.
en.native.full.style.element.header.caveats: This is visual presentation; it does not change the DOM tag into a semantic heading.
en.native.full.style.element.header.purpose: Present an element as a document heading.
en.native.full.style.element.image.behavior: Creates an img from src and alt, appends it to the host and removes that image when the style is removed.
en.native.full.style.element.image.composit: Use alt for the image meaning and size the surrounding element through normal styles.
en.native.full.style.element.image.purpose: Insert an image into an element.
en.native.full.style.element.list.behavior: Adds indentation/list classes and an optional order marker. With todo enabled, prepends a native checkbox switch initialized from checked and forwards host clicks through clickWith.
en.native.full.style.element.list.caveats: The caller owns the list data and persistence; the style does not parse Markdown or maintain a task model.
en.native.full.style.element.list.purpose: Render a list item or a simple task item.
en.native.full.style.element.para.behavior: Adds the para and indent-specific classes for document styling.
en.native.full.style.element.para.caveats: Supply content separately; this style does not parse text into document structure.
en.native.full.style.element.para.purpose: Present a document paragraph within JAML.
en.native.full.style.element.placeholder.be: Sets visibility to hidden, preserving its layout box.
en.native.full.style.element.placeholder.co: Use when the surrounding layout must remain stable; conditional rendering or display hiding serves a different purpose.
en.native.full.style.element.placeholder.pu: Reserve layout space while concealing an element.
en.native.full.style.element.quote.behavior: Adds the quote and indent-specific classes for document styling.
en.native.full.style.element.quote.caveats: Supply content separately; this style does not parse text into document structure.
en.native.full.style.element.quote.purpose: Present a document quote within JAML.
en.native.full.style.extraslot.hover2show.b: Adds show-on-hover and left/right placement classes and sets the extra action row direction.
en.native.full.style.extraslot.hover2show.c: Provide another accessible way to reach essential actions; this preset is hover presentation.
en.native.full.style.extraslot.hover2show.p: Requires content in the host extra slot.
en.native.full.style.gap.col.behavior: The atomic style writes the supplied value to column-gap.
en.native.full.style.gap.col.composition: Use the broader gap style when several related properties should be configured together.
en.native.full.style.gap.col.purpose: Set column-gap independently on the target.
en.native.full.style.gap.row.behavior: The atomic style writes the supplied value to row-gap.
en.native.full.style.gap.row.composition: Use the broader gap style when several related properties should be configured together.
en.native.full.style.gap.row.purpose: Set row-gap independently on the target.
en.native.full.style.grid.area.behavior: Writes grid-row-start, grid-column-start, and span-based row and column ends.
en.native.full.style.grid.area.composition: Apply to the item, while the parent owns grid track definitions.
en.native.full.style.grid.area.prerequisite: The target must be a grid item; supply meaningful spans because the factory interpolates them directly.
en.native.full.style.grid.area.purpose: Place an item by grid start coordinates and spans.
en.native.full.style.grid.virtualScroll.beh: Uses the component child-rendering controller with SaigonGrid, reserving fixed-height rows and mounting visible/buffered cells while retaining component identity.
en.native.full.style.grid.virtualScroll.cav: The grid controller owns cell positions; arbitrary per-cell row spans and freeform placement do not fit its regular row model.
en.native.full.style.grid.virtualScroll.com: Use layout.lazyload for variable-height vertical content and table.fixedrowheight for native table rows.
en.native.full.style.grid.virtualScroll.pre: Requires component-owned children, a positive fixed height and a bounded scroll viewport with regular grid columns.
en.native.full.style.grid.virtualScroll.pur: Virtualize a regular grid of component children.
en.native.full.style.group.bento.behavior: Adds the bento-group class and forwards padding, border, background and shadow variables to the group stylesheet.
en.native.full.style.group.bento.caveats: The current borderRadius assignment uses a misspelled variable; verify that override before depending on it.
en.native.full.style.group.bento.compositio: Combine with a native grid or flex layout; this style supplies surfaces rather than data or navigation.
en.native.full.style.group.bento.purpose: Give grouped children separate tile surfaces.
en.native.full.style.group.divider.behavior: Maintains divider elements before eligible direct children, synchronizing additions/removals and direction changes. Layer and divider children are excluded.
en.native.full.style.group.divider.composit: Use group.gridline for drawn cell borders; divider creates actual child elements.
en.native.full.style.group.divider.lifecycl: Shared per-host ownership keeps one divider set; the last owner disconnects observation and destroys owned dividers.
en.native.full.style.group.divider.purpose: Separate direct group content with native dividers.
en.native.full.style.group.gridline.behavio: Applies gridline variables and recomputes render-position markers on resize for inner and outer borders.
en.native.full.style.group.gridline.prerequ: Requires laid-out child boxes; choose grid/flex placement separately.
en.native.full.style.group.gridline.purpose: Draw a connected grid around grouped children.
en.native.full.style.group.stripy.behavior: Applies odd/even background variables and recomputes render-position markers on resize.
en.native.full.style.group.stripy.compositi: Use table.stripy for table cells; this preset decorates grouped children.
en.native.full.style.group.stripy.purpose: Alternate surfaces across a rendered group.
en.native.full.style.hover.bouncing.behavio: Adds the hover-bouncing class; it does not install a click handler.
en.native.full.style.hover.brighter.behavio: Adds hover-brighter and exposes b and s as effect variables.
en.native.full.style.hover.brighter.composi: Use for decorative pointer feedback alongside an independently defined action.
en.native.full.style.hover.brighter.purpose: Increase brightness and saturation on hover.
en.native.full.style.hover.dynamicbg.behavi: Adds the hover-dynamicbg class consumed by the hover stylesheet.
en.native.full.style.hover.dynamicbg.purpos: Add a moving background hover treatment.
en.native.full.style.hover.highlightcap.beh: Prepares a cap layer and adjusts/restores cap styling for non-button elements; button hosts use their existing presentation.
en.native.full.style.hover.highlightcap.lif: The owned layer is removed and saved caption styles are restored when unplugged.
en.native.full.style.hover.highlightcap.pur: Highlight a caption when its host is hovered.
en.native.full.style.hover.parallax.behavio: Delegates hover transforms to PineappleParallax after connection and removes its hover effect on unplug.
en.native.full.style.hover.parallax.caveats: A decorative pointer effect, not camera navigation; use interact.panNZoom for panning and zooming content.
en.native.full.style.hover.parallax.purpose: Add pointer-driven depth to a host.
en.native.full.style.hover.toShowAll.behavi: Detects overflow on the selected target, copies its text and selected styles into a body-level label, and removes the label on mouse leave.
en.native.full.style.hover.toShowAll.caveat: The popup contains text content, not a live copy of controls; essential content needs keyboard-accessible presentation as well.
en.native.full.style.hover.toShowAll.purpos: Reveal clipped text on pointer hover.
en.native.full.style.hover.withbg.behavior: Adds the hover-withbg class, allowing the role/accent stylesheet to choose the hover surface.
en.native.full.style.hover.withbg.purpose: Add a hover background using the native surface treatment.
en.native.full.style.icon.arrow.behavior: Appends a shaped arrow. Numeric input values choose up/down on valuechange; other hosts use stateDirections on statechange.
en.native.full.style.icon.arrow.caveats: autoDirection is declared but does not select the branch: host type does. The callback event name is not saved for cleanup, so repeated style replacement may retain listeners.
en.native.full.style.icon.arrow.purpose: Show a compact directional icon driven by value or state.
en.native.full.style.icon.bar.behavior: Adds a shaped-icon host class and appends a span with the bar icon class into slot icon.
en.native.full.style.icon.bar.composition: Use when a geometric marker is sufficient; supply semantic text through the host caption or accessible label.
en.native.full.style.icon.bar.purpose: Use a simple bar shape in the icon slot.

en.native.full.style.icon.brand.caveats: Existing complex icon markup is left untouched; the style does not download missing icon assets.
en.native.full.style.icon.brand.prerequisit: Requires a native icon slot with simple text content. Font-based variants require the corresponding icon font/assets.
en.native.full.style.icon.brand.purpose: Render an icon using the brand treatment.

en.native.full.style.icon.chars.purpose: Render an icon using the chars treatment.
en.native.full.style.icon.dot.behavior: Adds a shaped-icon host class and appends a span with the dot icon class into slot icon.
en.native.full.style.icon.dot.composition: Use when a geometric marker is sufficient; supply semantic text through the host caption or accessible label.
en.native.full.style.icon.dot.purpose: Use a simple dot shape in the icon slot.

en.native.full.style.icon.solid.purpose: Render an icon using the solid treatment.
en.native.full.style.icon.square.behavior: Adds a shaped-icon host class and appends a span with the square icon class into slot icon.
en.native.full.style.icon.square.compositio: Use when a geometric marker is sufficient; supply semantic text through the host caption or accessible label.
en.native.full.style.icon.square.purpose: Use a simple square shape in the icon slot.
en.native.full.style.icon.withbg.behavior: Finds the first i element in the icon slot and applies background variables plus its decoration class; removes those additions on unplug.
en.native.full.style.icon.withbg.prerequisi: Compose after an icon renderer that creates the i element; this style does not create the icon itself.
en.native.full.style.icon.withbg.purpose: Add a background to an existing rendered icon.
en.native.full.style.icon.withborder.behavi: Finds the first i element in the icon slot and applies border variables plus its decoration class; removes those additions on unplug.
en.native.full.style.icon.withborder.prereq: Compose after an icon renderer that creates the i element; this style does not create the icon itself.
en.native.full.style.icon.withborder.purpos: Add a border to an existing rendered icon.
en.native.full.style.indicator.bigicon.beha: Spans the icon across two grid rows and exposes its size; the caption and value remain separate slots.
en.native.full.style.indicator.bigicon.purp: Emphasize an indicator with a large icon.
en.native.full.style.indicator.centered.beh: Applies centered grid alignment, adjusting columns for hosts with or without an icon/unit.
en.native.full.style.indicator.centered.pur: Center an indicator metric and its surrounding slots.
en.native.full.style.indicator.clock.behavi: Builds a clock layer from the current timestamp and updates hand angles/date text on valuechange; clicks toggle presentation variants.
en.native.full.style.indicator.clock.caveat: The style does not start a timer. A zero timestamp is ignored, and the legacy clock display has fixed date-language fragments.
en.native.full.style.indicator.clock.lifecy: Removal removes the clock layer and value listener; this implementation does not restore setContentManually.
en.native.full.style.indicator.clock.prereq: Supply timestamp values and an external update source if the clock must tick.
en.native.full.style.indicator.clock.purpos: Render an indicator value as an analog or digital clock.
en.native.full.style.indicator.datetime.beh: Adds the datetime class and passes pattern into element parameters.
en.native.full.style.indicator.datetime.pre: Use the appropriate native date/time indicator type and provide a date-compatible value; the style alone does not select that type.
en.native.full.style.indicator.datetime.pur: Format a date/time indicator with a display pattern.
en.native.full.style.indicator.inline.behav: Places icon, caption, value and unit in a horizontal grid aligned to the baseline.
en.native.full.style.indicator.jaml.behavio: Adds logo and JAML variant classes; logo styling hides the normal value slot and draws the mark.
en.native.full.style.indicator.jaml.purpose: Display the native JAML wordmark treatment.
en.native.full.style.indicator.jamui.behavi: Adds logo and Jam-UI variant classes; logo styling hides the normal value slot and draws the mark.
en.native.full.style.indicator.jamui.purpos: Display the native Jam-UI wordmark treatment.
en.native.full.style.indicator.lefted.behav: Applies the lefted grid template and aligns the value to the start.
en.native.full.style.indicator.lefted.purpo: Align an indicator metric toward the leading edge.
en.native.full.style.indicator.tips.behavio: Changes to a padded wrapping inline-flex layout with an enlarged wrapping value and hides the unit.
en.native.full.style.indicator.tips.caveats: This is an inline presentation, not a popup tooltip plugin.
en.native.full.style.indicator.tips.purpose: Use an indicator as a prominent explanatory tip.
en.native.full.style.indicator.trailingIcon: Adds trailing-icon; label and indicator stylesheets position their own icon slots accordingly.
Place the icon after the caption/metric content.
en.native.full.style.indicator.tweening.beh: Uses valuechange old/new values to update the displayed content, either digit by digit or by numeric interpolation.
en.native.full.style.indicator.tweening.cav: The style takes manual control of displayed content. It does not retain cancellation handles or restore that flag on unplug; frequent replacement or overlapping updates need separate verification.
en.native.full.style.indicator.tweening.dia: Builds per-digit tracks in the value slot, chooses duration from digit-index distance and updates their CSS positions; removal restores normal formatted content.
This is a numeric display effect; arbitrary text and overlapping timeout cleanup are not guaranteed.
Use a numeric indicator and compatible digit sequence/format.
Display numeric changes as rolling digit dials.
en.native.full.style.indicator.tweening.pre: Use numeric values and a compatible numeric formatter.
en.native.full.style.indicator.unitTop.beha: Moves the unit to the first grid row and expands the value across two columns.
en.native.full.style.indicator.unitTop.purp: Place an indicator unit beside the caption above the value.
en.native.full.style.indicator.useArea.beha: Assigns icon, caption, value, unit and extra content to i, c, v, u and e grid areas.
en.native.full.style.indicator.useArea.comp: Use the native slot content and area-based grid styling when the default positional layout needs adjustment.
en.native.full.style.indicator.useArea.purp: Address indicator slots through named grid areas.
en.native.full.style.indicator.useLabel.beh: Displays the label slot as inline-flex and resets icon/caption area placement while adapting indicator columns.
en.native.full.style.indicator.useLabel.pur: Lay out an indicator through its combined label slot.
en.native.full.style.indicator.valueTop.beh: Moves the indicator icon, value and unit to the first grid row.
en.native.full.style.indicator.valueTop.pur: Place the metric above its caption.
en.native.full.style.input.autoRows.behavio: After value readiness, measures text rows on valuechange and resize and clamps the native textarea rows between minRows and maxRows.
en.native.full.style.input.autoRows.prerequ: Requires an input whose agent is an HTMLTextAreaElement; other input agents are ignored.
en.native.full.style.input.autoRows.purpose: Grow a textarea to fit its current text within row limits.
en.native.full.style.input.chocolate.behavi: Adds chocolate; the input template applies this treatment to the color input type.
en.native.full.style.input.chocolate.purpos: Give a color input the chocolate presentation.
en.native.full.style.input.code.behavior: Provides formatting options to the external style integration; its error path restores the native agent and resolves editor/formatter readiness.
en.native.full.style.input.code.caveats: This native entry does not itself bundle or initialize a code editor.
en.native.full.style.input.code.prerequisit: Requires the separate code-input integration for the editor behavior.
en.native.full.style.input.code.purpose: Configure the external code-editor integration for an input.
en.native.full.style.input.code.withPadding: Adds with-padding and sets the code-padding variable.
Compose with the installed code-input integration; this does not install an editor.
Adjust padding around an integrated code input.
en.native.full.style.input.showColorName.be: On initial application and valuechange, creates/updates a layer label using the uppercase Chroma color name and a readable foreground color.
en.native.full.style.input.showColorName.ca: This is a color label, not a palette registry or semantic color mapping.
en.native.full.style.input.showColorName.pu: Show the interpreted color name on a color input.
en.native.full.style.interact.clearable.beh: Creates an extra clear button that calls clear() only when the host satisfies the clearable interface.
en.native.full.style.interact.clearable.cav: The legacy button title is fixed text; localized applications should verify or replace that caption.
en.native.full.style.interact.clearable.pur: Add a clear action to a clearable element.
en.native.full.style.interact.closable.beha: Creates a close button and wires icon-slot double-click to it; the default callback removes the nearest closable host.
en.native.full.style.interact.closable.comp: Provide callback when closing must update application state or request confirmation.
en.native.full.style.interact.closable.purp: Add a close affordance to a host.
en.native.full.style.interact.expandable.be: Chooses a previous/next sibling from direction, adds an optional toggle button and resize edge, and can store expanded state and dimensions by host id.
en.native.full.style.interact.expandable.ca: This is a paired-panel interaction, not an arbitrary overlay. The resizable object is treated as enabled but its custom fields are not forwarded by this wrapper.
en.native.full.style.interact.expandable.li: Removal releases resize/listener/button ownership and removes expansion classes.
en.native.full.style.interact.expandable.pr: Requires the adjacent sibling and a measurable parent; saveState requires an id.
en.native.full.style.interact.expandable.pu: Expand one panel into an adjacent sibling’s space.
en.native.full.style.interact.panNZoom.beha: Installs Pear pan and zoom behavior on mount using the scale bounds/step. Unmount, style teardown or host destruction removes both; remount can install them again while the style remains applied.
en.native.full.style.interact.panNZoom.comp: Use for spatial content; interact.zoomable instead toggles a window-like host between normal and expanded size.
en.native.full.style.interact.panNZoom.purp: Pan and zoom a content surface.
en.native.full.style.interact.removable.beh: Creates a remove button; a synchronous onremove result of false vetoes removal, otherwise the host is removed.
en.native.full.style.interact.removable.cav: An asynchronous promise is not awaited as a veto. Keep application data and persistence synchronized in the callback.
en.native.full.style.interact.resettable.be: Creates an extra reset button which calls reset() when the host satisfies the resettable interface.
en.native.full.style.interact.resettable.pr: Requires a host reset() contract; the button does not define the default value.
en.native.full.style.interact.resettable.pu: Add a reset action to a resettable element.
en.native.full.style.interact.scrollWatcher: After a delay, listens to the resolved target and toggles jam-x-scrolled and jam-y-scrolled on the host.

The declared clazz argument is unused. Initial state is not computed until scrolling. Teardown leaves the last jam-x-scrolled and jam-y-scrolled classes in place; it does not restore their earlier values.

Unmount, style teardown or host destruction unbinds the actual resolved scroll target. Delayed setup and throttled callbacks check application identity, so obsolete work is inert; remount can establish a new listener.
Expose whether a scroll container has moved from its origin.
en.native.full.style.interact.scrollX.behav: Installs a non-passive throttled wheel listener that prevents default scrolling and converts vertical-only deltas into smooth horizontal movement.
en.native.full.style.interact.scrollX.cavea: This consumes the wheel event; nested scrolling and trackpads need interaction checks.
en.native.full.style.interact.scrollX.prere: The host must have horizontal overflow.
en.native.full.style.interact.scrollX.purpo: Use a vertical wheel gesture to scroll a horizontal strip.
en.native.full.style.interact.virtualScroll: Creates a SaigonScroll for the host and resolved scroll target, passing the supplied row providers and fixed row height. It attaches scroll and resize listeners; the generic style does not perform an initial draw.
Use grid.virtualScroll for component grids, layout.lazyload for variable-height vertical components and table.fixedrowheight for native table rows.
Removal detaches SaigonScroll listeners but retains the instance on the host; attaching this style again to that host does not create or initialize a replacement.

Supply getRowNum and getChildrenByRow callbacks, a stable row height, and a measurable scroll target. Returned row children must expose row, buildDom(), and dom when built. The caller must provide row positioning and the full scrollable extent.

en.native.full.style.interact.zoomable.beha: Creates a zoom button and label-slot double-click trigger; the default callback toggles host geometry with a position transition.
en.native.full.style.interact.zoomable.cave: This changes window-like layout size; use interact.panNZoom for a content camera.
en.native.full.style.interact.zoomable.life: The label-slot double-click listener is installed for each active mount and removed on unmount, style teardown or host destruction. The style’s owned zoom button is removed on teardown.

en.plugin.interact.draggable.behavior: Enables browser dragging and writes a truthy data callback result as application/json. With selector, it prepares existing matching descendants; for each beforechildadd event, it checks only the first child and prepares it if it matches.
en.plugin.interact.draggable.caveats: It does not move layout coordinates or update collection order. A pre-existing draggable host is left unchanged. Teardown clears draggable state but the helper does not remove its previously registered drag listeners.
en.plugin.interact.draggable.composition: Pair with interact.droppable for data transfer. Use the interact.movable style to reposition a host, or interact.sortable to reorder peer items.
en.plugin.interact.draggable.prerequisites: Provide a browser drag source and a data callback returning the intended payload. Selector-based future-child discovery depends on the host emitting beforechildadd.
en.plugin.interact.draggable.purpose: Use native HTML drag-and-drop to transfer data from a host or matching descendants.
en.plugin.interact.droppable.behavior: Registers a drop zone and displays a curtain prompt for accepted drags. Dropping on that curtain passes data decoded from application/json or text/plain to dataHandler; handler receives the drop event with that payload exposed through its data property.
en.plugin.interact.droppable.caveats: This is not a file importer or a security boundary. It does not automatically move nodes, persist data or provide keyboard drag-and-drop. Unplug removes the drop-zone registration; document drag listeners remain shared.
en.plugin.interact.droppable.composition: Pair with interact.draggable for in-app data transfer. Let the handler validate the payload and update application state; use sortable for peer reordering.
en.plugin.interact.droppable.prerequisites: Use a browser drop flow with a visible target. Supply an accept function when filtering is required; non-function accept values currently fall back to accepting drags.
en.plugin.interact.droppable.purpose: Use a native browser drop target to receive data and run application handlers.
en.plugin.observe.child.appearance: No visual output; callbacks may update application presentation.
en.plugin.observe.child.args.childChanged.d: Callback for the added and removed sets
en.plugin.observe.child.behavior: Observes childList only. By default only HTMLElement nodes pass the filter. Added/removed callbacks receive the node with this=node; changed receives filtered arrays with this=root.
en.plugin.observe.child.caveats: Callbacks are per mutation record; changed can receive empty arrays and the filter may run repeatedly. Do not treat this as subtree observation or automatic child lifecycle management.
en.plugin.observe.child.composition: A supplied filter replaces the default and must handle every node. Scan existing children yourself if needed; this plugin neither enumerates them initially nor observes descendant or attribute changes.
en.plugin.observe.child.lifecycle: Stores the MutationObserver on plug and disconnects it on unplug, then removes plugin data.
en.plugin.observe.child.prerequisites: Use a DOM host with MutationObserver available and callbacks appropriate for the accepted nodes.
en.plugin.observe.child.purpose: React to subsequent direct-child additions and removals without owning the child UI.
en.plugin.router.appearance: Route content defines the visuals; the plugin itself does not create a navigation bar or page design.
en.plugin.router.behavior: Uses the supplied type when present, otherwise the shared AbstractRouter type. hash selects hash routing and other values select history; a supplied type changes that shared default. It forwards remaining options, assigns the host, marks it and initializes the router.
en.plugin.router.caveats: Teardown does not restore the shared route type, browser URL/history or previous host content. Open-key acceptance does not validate every route field or promise cancellation of all application work.
en.plugin.router.composition: Supply routes and loading policies through the underlying jam.AbstractRouter contract. Keep navigation controls and nested content ownership explicit; this metadata is an open forwarding schema.
en.plugin.router.lifecycle: On unplug destroys the owned router and clears the host router reference, marker and plugin data. Router destruction removes its route/load listeners and owned child-router state.
en.plugin.router.prerequisites: Provide a suitable content host, route/content configuration and URL mode. History-based deployments need compatible server fallback behavior.
en.plugin.router.purpose: Attach URL-driven route resolution to an author-supplied content host.
en.plugin.subRouter.behavior: Uses type to select the implementation, forwards remaining constructor arguments except routes, and registers supplied routes on the child router.
en.plugin.subRouter.lifecycle: Links the child to its parent and initializes it passively; unplug clears its route link, destroys it and refreshes parent route watchers.
en.plugin.subRouter.purpose: Attach a router beneath the nearest parent router, falling back to the global router.
en.style.check.frame.purpose: Use a frame around the current selected option when the option element already owns selection.
en.style.check.pipe.purpose: Use a side bar beside the current selected option when the option element already owns selection.
en.style.check.shade.purpose: Use a shaded background behind the current selected option when the option element already owns selection.
en.style.check.shared.behavior: On valuechange, locate the first checked DOM item, or hide the existing locator when none is checked. A configured delay is used before the first locator is created; the style does not change the selected value.
en.style.check.shared.caveats: This is one visual marker, not a marker for every checked item. It does not implement tabs keyboard navigation, ARIA tab semantics or panel switching.
en.style.check.shared.composition: Let the native option element own selection and bind its value to application state. Choose one check locator variant for that host.
en.style.check.shared.prerequisites: Use an option host exposing checked items, valuechange and locator methods, such as radio or buttongroup-radio. Plain buttongroup has no selection mode; choose an explicit radio or checkbox subtype.
en.style.check.underscore.purpose: Use an underline below the current selected option when the option element already owns selection.
en.style.click.able.appearance: Theme-provided pointer, hover and active presentation follows the framework stylesheets.
en.style.click.able.behavior: Combines the clickable class with stylize=button; it installs no activation handler.
en.style.click.able.caveats: Styling does not add keyboard activation, tabIndex, an accessible role, disabled behavior or a click callback.
en.style.click.able.composition: Prefer a native button when that is the intended control. For a custom host, supply activation, focus and semantic attributes explicitly.
en.style.click.able.lifecycle: Ordinary class and attribute plugins track and restore their presentation changes.
en.style.click.able.prerequisites: Use a host with the intended interaction and accessibility contract; load the theme and framework styles.
en.style.click.able.purpose: Give a custom host the framework clickable/button presentation while the application supplies interaction semantics.
en.style.click.bouncing.behavior: Adds hover-bouncing and active-bouncing classes; visual behavior is supplied by the framework stylesheet.
en.style.click.toFront.appearance: Changes stacking order without moving or reparenting DOM nodes.
en.style.click.toFront.behavior: Raises the host immediately; after connected readiness, installs a mousedown listener that raises it again. Assigns inline z-index and sortable/top markers among descendant sortable peers under the parent.
en.style.click.toFront.caveats: This is not a global-topmost or focus-trapping modal manager. Already-topmost nodes return early; arbitrary reparenting is not reconciled.
en.style.click.toFront.composition: Use with positioned peer cards or windows; manage layout, parent changes and modal focus separately.
en.style.click.toFront.lifecycle: Teardown removes the mousedown listener and sortable markers, promotes a remaining sortable, and clears plugin data. A pending connected-readiness callback cannot reinstall an obsolete listener. Prior inline z-index values are not restored.
en.style.click.toFront.prerequisites: Provide suitable positioning and a shared stacking context, with framework z-index tokens available.
en.style.click.toFront.purpose: Bring positioned peer content forward within its parent stacking context.
en.style.hover.crosshair.purpose: Use corner brackets to highlight a hovered element without changing selection.
en.style.hover.frame.purpose: Use frame to highlight a hovered element without changing selection.
en.style.hover.locator.behavior: Marks the host as a locator target and, after connected readiness, installs parent hover handling. A shared locator follows the hovered marked element and hides when that target emits mouseleave or unmount.
en.style.hover.locator.caveats: The locator is shared across calls, so do not assume independent simultaneous markers or independent option settings across hosts. Hover feedback supplies no selection state, keyboard activation or focus semantics.
en.style.hover.locator.composition: Use check styles for persistent selection feedback and layer.crosshair for a host-anchored breathing decoration; hover locators only follow the current hover target.
en.style.hover.locator.prerequisites: Provide a connected host with a parent and the framework locator styles.
en.style.hover.shade.purpose: Use shade to highlight a hovered element without changing selection.
en.style.interact.movable.appearance: Movement is provided by the helper; this style supplies no dedicated control or keyboard UI.
en.style.interact.movable.behavior: Forwards supplied arguments unchanged to jam.makeMovable; no argument profile defaults are added.
en.style.interact.movable.caveats: Disabling movement does not restore previous coordinates or remove shared global gesture handlers. Keyboard interaction, accessibility, geometry constraints and application position persistence remain caller responsibilities.
en.style.interact.movable.composition: Compose with the host layout and any stacking behavior deliberately. Detailed forwarded fields are not described by this open catalog schema.
en.style.interact.movable.lifecycle: Runs on mount, or immediately for an already-mounted framework host or connected ordinary element. Unmount, style teardown or host destruction calls makeUnmovable for the active setup; remount can enable it again while the style remains installed.
en.style.interact.movable.prerequisites: Provide an appropriate mounted/connected host and the needed geometry, handle and containment choices from the helper contract.
en.style.interact.movable.purpose: Enable pointer-driven movement of a host through the existing movement helper.
en.style.interact.resizable.appearance: The helper manages resizing; the style does not create a complete accessible resize control.
en.style.interact.resizable.behavior: Forwards supplied arguments unchanged to jam.makeResizable; no argument profile defaults are added.
en.style.interact.resizable.caveats: Disabling does not restore original dimensions. A queued debounce or animationEnd promise may still finish, but its obsolete continuation is inert. Shared passive ResizeObserver ownership is unchanged; disable does not unobserve even a sole former resize target. Keyboard controls, accessibility and size persistence remain caller responsibilities.
en.style.interact.resizable.composition: Keep sizing constraints consistent with parent layout. Detailed forwarded fields remain outside this open schema; editor acceptance does not prove their runtime validity.
en.style.interact.resizable.lifecycle: Runs on mount or an already-mounted/connected host. Unmount, style teardown or host destruction calls makeUnresizable. Disable removes this resize instance’s passiveresize, resize and moveend listeners; obsolete debounce and animation-completion continuations cannot reset a removed or replacement instance.
en.style.interact.resizable.prerequisites: Provide an appropriate mounted/connected host, meaningful size/position constraints and helper-specific handle or containment settings.
en.style.interact.resizable.purpose: Enable pointer-driven host resizing through the existing resizing helper.
en.style.interact.sortable.behavior: Manages the drag preview and commits child order on drop. change receives the source, destination, old/new indices and item lists when order or container changes.
en.style.interact.sortable.caveats: Reordering rendered elements does not persist the application model. Keyboard reordering and accessible announcements require a separate application contract.
en.style.interact.sortable.composition: Use change to synchronize application data order. Use movable for free positioning and draggable/droppable for native browser data transfer.
en.style.interact.sortable.prerequisites: Provide a container with matching direct child items and appropriate handle/avoid choices. Use a shared nonempty group only for intended transfers.
en.style.interact.sortable.purpose: Use drag reordering for matching direct children, with optional transfers between containers sharing a group.
en.style.layer.crosshair.behavior: Creates a crosshair locator targeted at the host. Mouse entry and movement trigger breathing; mouse leave returns it to a steady state.
en.style.layer.crosshair.caveats: It does not select the host, move application content or supply keyboard/focus behavior.
en.style.layer.crosshair.composition: Use hover.crosshair for a marker that moves between hovered targets, check.frame for selected options, or a layer.follower variant with follow true for pointer-following decoration.
en.style.layer.crosshair.lifecycle: The crosshair child removes its host mouse listeners on unmount.
en.style.layer.crosshair.prerequisites: Use a host whose bounds should be outlined and load the framework locator styles.
en.style.layer.crosshair.purpose: Use a host-anchored corner-bracket decoration that reacts to pointer activity without following pointer coordinates.
en.style.layer.follower.edge.purpose: Use a glowing edge as optional decorative pointer feedback.
en.style.layer.follower.shadow.purpose: Use a cursor-reactive shadow as optional decorative pointer feedback.
en.style.layer.follower.shared.behavior: Creates a decorative layer. Pointer movement updates it only when follow is true; otherwise its configured position remains in use.
en.style.layer.follower.shared.caveats: Movement is driven by document mouse events, not selection state or a complete touch/keyboard interaction. Containment, clipping and stacking affect the visible result.
en.style.layer.follower.shared.composition: Choose spotlight for a glow, edge for a rim, or shadow for an offset shadow. Use layer.crosshair when the decoration should stay anchored to the host.
en.style.layer.follower.shared.prerequisite: Load framework layer styles and give the host usable geometry. Enable follow explicitly when pointer tracking is required.
en.style.layer.follower.spotlight.purpose: Use a spotlight glow as optional decorative pointer feedback.
en.style.layer.spinner.background.behavior: Builds a masked background layer; spin controls its rotation.
en.style.layer.spinner.background.purpose: Use a ring background for optional decorative activity feedback.
en.style.layer.spinner.comet.behavior: Builds a gradient arc with head and tail controls. spin rotates it; animateLength independently enables repeated arc-length animation.
en.style.layer.spinner.comet.purpose: Use a comet arc for optional decorative activity feedback.
en.style.layer.spinner.frets.behavior: Builds a conic segmented ring from fret settings; spin controls its rotation.
en.style.layer.spinner.frets.purpose: Use a segmented ring for optional decorative activity feedback.
en.style.layer.spinner.object.behavior: Uses text characters first, then objectJAML, then objectHTML to create repeated content. spin controls orbital motion; content and rotation settings remain caller-owned.
en.style.layer.spinner.object.purpose: Use repeated objects or text around a ring for optional decorative activity feedback.
en.style.layer.spinner.orbit.behavior: Builds radial dot images and an optional orbit track. spin rotates the layer.
en.style.layer.spinner.orbit.purpose: Use orbiting dots for optional decorative activity feedback.
en.style.layer.spinner.particles.behavior: Creates a canvas particle effect during resize setup using the configured inner and outer radii; particle animation is separate from spin rotation.
en.style.layer.spinner.particles.purpose: Use a circular particle effect for optional decorative activity feedback.
en.style.layer.spinner.shared.caveats: These are decorative layers: they do not detect pending work, report progress, announce status or disable controls. The spin default is false; particles and optional variant animations can still animate independently.
en.style.layer.spinner.shared.composition: Choose the visual variant independently of application busy/progress state. The application decides when to attach or remove it; use a progress element for measured progress.
en.style.layer.spinner.shared.prerequisites: Provide a host with measurable height when using percentage size, and load framework layer styles. Enable spin explicitly for rotation.
en.style.layout.application.appearance: The default grid reserves sidebar, header, content and footer areas. frame switches to a row layout with a column frame region.
en.style.layout.application.behavior: Adds a grid shell and classes for viewport, frame and scroll mode. content makes the designated main/content region scroll; regions hides its overflow so the author can provide inner scrollers.
en.style.layout.application.caveats: The style does not infer regions, create children or automatically make each region scroll. A tabs/navigation builder and application routing remain separate responsibilities.
en.style.layout.application.composition: Direct children use jam-sidebar-style, jam-header-style, jam-main-style or jam-layout-content, and jam-footer-style. With frame true, place header/main/footer inside jam-frame-style. In regions mode explicitly size and enable scrolling on inner regions.
en.style.layout.application.lifecycle: Uses reversible class plugins; it does not construct, destroy or observe regions.
en.style.layout.application.prerequisites: Provide a bounded-height parent unless viewport is true. Load the framework stylesheet and supply children carrying the expected role classes.
en.style.layout.application.purpose: Use for a bounded workspace shell with author-supplied regions and an explicit scroll owner.
en.style.layout.autogrid.behavior: Builds CSS repeat tracks from repeat and sizing arguments. Its default repeat is auto-fill; a numeric repeat fixes a count rather than adapting the column count automatically.
en.style.layout.autogrid.caveats: This is CSS grid repetition, not masonry or content-aware packing. Numeric repeat selects a fixed count; verify track sizing against the available space.
en.style.layout.autogrid.composition: Use width or minWidth/maxWidth to express track sizing. Use layout.grid when explicit row/column coordinates are required.
en.style.layout.autogrid.prerequisites: Load the framework stylesheet and distinguish the container layout from child placement.
en.style.layout.autogrid.purpose: Use size-driven grid repetition for repeated cards or tiles.
en.style.layout.flex.behavior: Combines flex and alignment arguments on a flex container. Framework styles enable wrapping unless overridden.
en.style.layout.flex.caveats: It does not create children, semantic roles or route/content hosts.
en.style.layout.flex.composition: Use grid or autogrid when two-dimensional track relationships matter. Keep shell regions and scrolling with the chosen page/application layout.
en.style.layout.flex.prerequisites: Load the framework stylesheet and distinguish the container layout from child placement.
en.style.layout.flex.purpose: Use a row or column flow with flexible alignment and wrapping.
en.style.layout.grid.behavior: Sets grid counts and track variables; size supplies rows then columns. withHeader reserves an automatic first row.
en.style.layout.grid.caveats: It arranges supplied children; it does not create application regions or assign data positions.
en.style.layout.grid.composition: Place gridpos or gridsize on child items. Use autogrid for size-driven wrapping and flex for a one-dimensional row or column.
en.style.layout.grid.prerequisites: Load the framework stylesheet and distinguish the container layout from child placement.
en.style.layout.grid.purpose: Use an explicit equal-track grid for a known row/column arrangement.
en.style.layout.gridpos.behavior: Maps left/top to column/row starts and width/height to column/row spans.
en.style.layout.gridpos.caveats: The parent must provide grid layout. It does not position the parent or create tracks; supply meaningful start/span values.
en.style.layout.gridpos.composition: Apply to a child of layout.grid or another explicit CSS grid; use gridsize when only spans are needed.
en.style.layout.gridpos.prerequisites: Load the framework stylesheet and distinguish the container layout from child placement.
en.style.layout.gridpos.purpose: Use explicit starting grid lines and spans for one child inside a grid.
en.style.layout.gridsize.behavior: Sets grid-row-end and grid-column-end spans from height and width.
en.style.layout.gridsize.caveats: It has no grid-placement effect without a grid parent and does not create tracks.
en.style.layout.gridsize.composition: Apply to a grid child; use gridpos when explicit start lines are also required.
en.style.layout.gridsize.prerequisites: Load the framework stylesheet and distinguish the container layout from child placement.
en.style.layout.gridsize.purpose: Use row and column spans for a child while leaving its starting position to grid placement.
en.style.layout.navigator.behavior: On resize, checks vertical overflow and moves the first descendant button group between inline placement and a burger-triggered popup.
en.style.layout.navigator.caveats: The implementation assumes a button group exists and moves that node. It does not provide a complete accessible tabs contract or infer selection mode from navigation appearance.
en.style.layout.navigator.composition: Bind the selected value to routing or content switching separately. This helper changes presentation of the supplied group; it does not create routes.
en.style.layout.navigator.prerequisites: Provide a descendant jam-buttongroup and constrained host geometry. Use buttongroup-radio when the navigation needs one selected value.
en.style.layout.navigator.purpose: Use an overflow fallback for an existing button-group navigation strip.
en.style.layout.overflow.appearance: Overflow is applied as CSS; temporary clipping hides content outside the host.
en.style.layout.overflow.args.animaDelay.co: The delay starts after animationend. Teardown removes listeners and the clipping marker added by this application, preserves a pre-existing marker, and makes an already-queued debounce inert without cancelling its timer.
en.style.layout.overflow.behavior: A truthy all overrides x/y. With truthy animaDelay, mount adds jam-no-overflow; bubbling animationend events restart a debounce that removes the marker after the delay only if it was absent when this style was applied.
en.style.layout.overflow.caveats: The delay starts after animationend, not mount. Without an end event clipping can remain; descendant events are not filtered and animationcancel is not handled.
en.style.layout.overflow.composition: Compose with an entry animation that actually emits animationend. Specify all or per-axis policies; x and y default to auto.
en.style.layout.overflow.lifecycle: Teardown removes installed listeners and plugin data, and removes the temporary clipping marker only if it was absent before application. A marker that existed before application is preserved. Already-queued debounce work may still run, but its application-identity check makes it inert.
en.style.layout.overflow.prerequisites: Use on a host that receives the expected mount and animationend events. Clipping is not immediately applied when attaching to an already-mounted host.
en.style.layout.overflow.purpose: Choose overflow policy and optionally clip content around mount-triggered entry animations.
en.style.layout.page.appearance: The layout arranges content; it does not choose a visual theme or create page regions.
en.style.layout.page.behavior: Adds the layout-page class: a relative column flex layout with full width, automatic height and visible overflow.
en.style.layout.page.caveats: It does not fill the viewport, build a shell or choose inner scroll owners. The application owns those decisions.
en.style.layout.page.composition: Supply children yourself. Direct main-style or layout-content children remain auto-sized with visible overflow; avoid conflicting fixed-height or clipping rules.
en.style.layout.page.lifecycle: Uses the ordinary reversible class plugin; it has no observer or custom lifecycle callback.
en.style.layout.page.prerequisites: Load the framework stylesheet and provide the page contents. The host should participate in document flow.
en.style.layout.page.purpose: Use for content-led document pages that should grow with their contents.
